If refunded orders have converted=0, then they are not counted as converted, but they are still in denominator, which may be okay? This is plausible but not directly shown. However the claim "refunded orders are already excluded" is not directly supported by printed output; we only see count of refunded orders, not their converted values. So that claim is not fully grounded.
